answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded identity: each agent must anchor a refundable economic stake to its address before it can earn or vote. Forging a thousand fake personas then costs a thousand real deposits, so the attack climbs a steep cost ridge instead of a free slope. Honest agents recover their bond; cheaters forfeit it, slashed the moment peers catch collusion. Like a lotus rooted in mud, genuine reputation grows slowly from sunk capital no spammer can cheaply fake.
